definitions.explanation: A broad plan or vision for something to be created or achieved. Used for large-scale ideas such as urban development plans, novel plots, business strategies, or architectural designs. Implies creative or strategic thinking at a high level.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧{構想|こうそう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{練|ね}る→練る：09751_neru⟧。
examples.english: To work out a new concept.

examples.japanese: ⟦{小説|しょうせつ}→小説：01434_shousetsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{構想|こうそう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦できている→できる：00557_dekiru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦まだ→まだ：00603_mada⟧⟦{書|か}き{始|はじ}めていない→書き始める：22272_kakihajimeru⟧。
examples.english: I have the concept for the novel, but I haven't started writing yet.

examples.japanese: ⟦{市長|しちょう}→市長：12472_shichou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{駅前|えきまえ}→駅前：09593_ekimae⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{再開発|さいかいはつ}→再開発：17066_saikaihatsu⟧⟦について→〜について：03103_nitsuite⟧⟦{壮大|そうだい}→壮大：10900_soudai⟧な{構想|こうそう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{発表|はっぴょう}した→発表する：25231_happyousuru⟧。
examples.english: The mayor announced a grand vision for the redevelopment of the area in front of the station.

notes:
ETYMOLOGY:
{構|こう} (to construct, to plan) + {想|そう} (thought, idea). Literally "constructed thought" — a carefully built-up idea.

USAGE:
{構想|こうそう} implies a big-picture plan that has been thought through, but not necessarily finalized or implemented. It is commonly used with ⟦{練|ね}る→練る：09751_neru⟧ (to work out, to refine) and ⟦{立|た}てる→立てる：01196_tateru⟧ (to set up). As a ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ verb, {構想|こうそう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ means "to conceive a plan."

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {構想|こうそう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{練|ね}る→練る：09751_neru⟧: to work out / refine a concept
- {構想|こうそう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{立|た}てる→立てる：01196_tateru⟧: to formulate a plan
- {構想|こうそう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{発表|はっぴょう}する→発表する：25231_happyousuru⟧: to announce a plan
- ⟦{壮大|そうだい}→壮大：10900_soudai⟧な{構想|こうそう}: a grand vision
- {構想|こうそう}⟦{段階|だんかい}→段階：04515_dankai⟧: planning stage
